expected_behavior: Flags, each with its fixtures/handler.go line, the fmt.Errorf in Load that uses %v instead of %w and so destroys the sql.ErrNoRows sentinel, and the discarded error in Handler (`o, _ := Load(id)`)

query: Aggiungi table-driven test per l'order service
expected_behavior: Tests are table driven: one slice of cases driving a single subtest loop, not copy pasted test functions
Every produced .go file is gofmt clean as written: tab indentation, a single grouped import block, no manual column alignment and no trailing whitespace
All file content is written with the Write or Edit tool, never through a Bash heredoc or redirect

The table cases are named for the `testing-standards` scenario taxonomy (happy path, boundary, invalid input, error propagation) and each subtest is registered with t.Run using a {func}_{condition}_{outcome} name

query: Scrivi un servizio HTTP in Go con chi, log/slog e context propagation
expected_behavior: context.Context is plumbed through every I/O path rather than created ad hoc inside the handler
http.Server is configured with explicit read, write and idle timeouts
Every goroutine started is paired with an explicit stop signal (context cancellation or a done channel), and the produced go.mod requires nothing beyond the chi router and the standard library
